items.title: AB InBev snatches the Champions League from Heineken after 33 years
items.summary: After more than three decades, Heineken must make way for Stella Artois in the Champions League. For AB InBev, the deal fits into its strategy of linking its biggest brands more closely to global media platforms and sporting events. The brewer is “well on its way,” CEO Michel…

items.title: Merger creates one-billion-euro pizza group
items.summary: European Pizza Group, the owner of the Wagner and Buitoni pizza brands, is set to merge with the British pizza manufacturer Crosta Mollica. Together, they will form a group with revenue of 1 billion euros.

items.title: Crosta Mollica merges with Nestlé pizza spin-off in Europe
items.summary: Crosta Mollica has merged with the European pizza business spun-off by Nestlé into a venture with private-equity firm PAI Partners. The post Crosta Mollica merges with Nestlé pizza spin-off in Europe appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: Dutch people spend 2.1 billion euros a year on groceries in Germany and Belgium
items.summary: More and more Dutch people are shopping across the border—especially in Germany, but also in Belgium. The food industry fears that if the Dutch government introduces a sugar tax, this trend will only gain momentum, since price is the main driver of cross-border shopping.

items.title: Additional handling fee adds another 2 euros to the cost of e-commerce packages
items.summary: The European Commission wants to set the additional handling fee for small packages from outside the EU at 2 euros. The measure primarily affects packages from Chinese online retailers such as Shein, Temu, and Alibaba.

items.title: IKEA to bring compact store format to the Netherlands, but not (yet) to Belgium
items.summary: IKEA plans to open five smaller stores in the Netherlands starting next year. The home furnishings chain is also rolling out this compact concept elsewhere in Europe. In Belgium, however, the time is not yet right.

items.title: Gamma chairs barred: Vincent Sheppard wins plagiarism case
items.summary: Furniture manufacturer Vincent Sheppard has obtained a court order in The Hague prohibiting Intergamma from continuing to sell its Amelie garden chairs and lounge sets in the European Union. According to the judge, the models are virtually identical to Vincent Sheppard’s Kodo…

items.title: Van Eerd appeals conviction: “the Public Prosecutor made a mess of it”
items.summary: The appeal by former Jumbo CEO Frits van Eerd begins with a heated clash between his new attorneys and the Public Prosecutor’s Office. The defense argues that crucial documents are missing and wants to significantly expand the investigation. Van Eerd is thus challenging his…

items.title: Diageo brings in former Britvic, Tesco executive Joanne Wilson as CFO
items.summary: Diageo has named former Tesco executive Joanne Wilson as CFO of the drinks giant, replacing the outgoing Nik Jhangiani.

items.title: Years to resume dog-food deliveries after recall
items.summary: Years is set to resume dog food deliveries after an independent probe found “no evidence” linking its recipes to a dry eye condition. The post Years to resume dog-food deliveries after recall appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: Metro AG Names New Chief Executive
items.summary: Wholesale giant Metro AG has named its current chief financial officer Eric Riegger as its next CEO, effective from 1 October.

items.title: Sixty candidates are vying for Batavus and Sparta
items.summary: As many as sixty parties have approached the receivers of bicycle manufacturer Accell with proposals for a restart of (parts of) the company. Accell, the parent company of brands such as Batavus, Sparta, and Koga, filed for bankruptcy last month.

items.title: “We’re very optimistic” – Chapel Down CEO on H1 growth and the push for 1% of the Champagne market
items.summary: Chapel Down CEO James Pennefather on H1 momentum, millennial demand, exports and why English fizz can rival Champagne.

items.title: Good Culture names COO to scale supply chain
items.summary: Kirk Jensen will focus on strengthening supply chain and manufacturing operations at the cottage cheese maker to improve availability and speed to shelf for retail partners, CEO Jesse Merrill said.

items.title: Ferrero relaunches Wonka candy brand
items.summary: The food giant is releasing a line of limited-edition treats with unexpected colors and texture combinations to attract a new generation of consumers.

items.title: NorgesGruppen Adds Another €9.24m To Food Industry Sustainability Fund
items.summary: Norwegian grocery group NorgesGruppen has committed another NOK 100 million (€9.24 million) to its HANDLE sustainability fund.

items.title: H&M boosts profits, but sales growth remains sluggish
items.summary: The H&M Group is seeing its cost savings and more efficient sourcing have an increasingly significant impact on its profits. The Swedish fashion group reported stronger-than-expected profit growth in the third quarter, while revenue remained virtually unchanged. CEO Daniel Ervér…

items.title: Wegmans Food Markets Invests Almost €97m In Supply Chain Overhaul
items.summary: US supermarket chain Wegmans has unveiled a $110 million (€96.7 million) investment strategy to modernise its supply chain.

items.title: Lidl Owner Among Bidders For Tesco's Central European Business: Reports
items.summary: German discount retailer Lidl's owner Schwarz Group is among the potential bidders for Tesco's Central European business, according to reports.

items.title: US judge cuts Beyond Meat trademark penalty
items.summary: A US judge has reduced Beyond Meat’s trademark infringement penalty from a lawsuit brought by Sonate, the parent company of Vegadelphia Foods. The post US judge cuts Beyond Meat trademark penalty appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: Deliveroo And Frozen-Food Retailer Picard Partner All Across France
items.summary: Frozen-food retailer Picard and Deliveroo have expanded their partnership all over France, delivering products in 30 minutes.

items.title: Carrefour Belgium launches fourth edition of Scanmania: shoppers can win a kilogram of gold
items.summary: Carrefour Belgium is once again running its large-scale “Scanmania” promotional campaign through October 28. That means not only significant discounts and thousands of free products, but also the chance to win a gold bar.

items.title: Britain's Co-op Group Posts Bigger First-Half Loss As Investments Weigh
items.summary: Britain's Co-op Group posted a bigger first-half loss on Wednesday as spending on promotions and store improvements weighed on profitability.

items.title: UK watchdog issues ABP, Dovecote Park autonomy notice
items.summary: The UK competition watchdog has ordered ABP Food Group and Dovecote Park’s owner to keep their businesses separate. The post UK watchdog issues ABP, Dovecote Park autonomy notice appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: Impossible Foods Marks Entry Into UK Retail With Tesco Launch
items.summary: Impossible Foods has entered the UK grocery market with the rollout of four plant-based products at Tesco.

items.title: Impossible Foods marks UK retail debut in market set to “rebound”
items.summary: Impossible Foods has made its UK retail bow in a market where the US-headquartered plant-based meat business sees signs of a “rebound”. The post Impossible Foods marks UK retail debut in market set to “rebound” appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: Ahold Delhaize, Lidl, and Biedronka to bid on Tesco stores in Central Europe
items.summary: Now that Tesco wants to leave the continent to focus on its home market, interested parties are stepping forward to take over the British market leader's operations in Central Europe.

items.title: Lidl Portugal Achieves Sustainable Targets For Own-Brand Tea With WWF
items.summary: Lidl Portugal has achieved its sustainability targets for its own black, green and rooibos teas, in partnership with the WWF.

items.title: Bayern Munich coach Vincent Kompany becomes a Foodmaker ambassador
items.summary: Foodmaker, the Belgian producer of healthy, fresh meals, is entering into a partnership with Vincent Kompany. The FC Bayern Munich coach will serve as the brand’s ambassador, as the company has ambitious growth plans in Europe.

items.title: LEAD Network Membership Hits New Milestone
items.summary: LEAD Network, which promotes gender equality and workplace inclusion, has reached a milestone of 30,000 members as growth continues to accelerate.

items.title: John Lewis brings forward the Christmas countdown as shoppers get festive early
items.summary: Christmas has arrived early at John Lewis, with the retailer opening its festive shop 93 days before the big day as shoppers begin preparing for the season. The department store has opened its Christmas shops across the country, with decorations, gifts, wrapping paper, tableware…

items.title: The Next Generation of Reusable Bags: Dish X Anya Hindmarch Universal Bag Arrives at Waitrose
items.summary: A new pink reusable tote featuring green stripes and the Dish from Waitrose branding is set to bring a little more style to the weekly shop. Available nationwide from the end of September for £15, the limited-edition bag comes in an exclusive pink colourway. Made from 100%…

items.title: Gimber turns to profit thanks to cans and sharper focus
items.summary: After a few difficult years, Gimber has returned to profitability. The Belgian ginger drink brand cut costs and expanded into export markets, while cans and new flavors are driving growth.

items.title: González Byass promotes Murillo to top job
items.summary: González Byass has named Enrique Murillo, its international business director, as the wine-and-spirits group’s new general manager.

items.title: NZ wine export volumes rise – but value sales flat
items.summary: New Zealand’s winemakers grew their export volumes by 6% in the year to the end of June, although value sales remained flat.

items.title: Goldfish dives into protein with new cracker
items.summary: After admitting it was slow to innovate the popular snack, Campbell’s has been actively bringing the offering into new categories.

items.title: Brown-Forman relaunches El Jimador Tequila in India
items.summary: Brown-Forman has reintroduced its Tequila brand El Jimador to the Indian market with a “refreshed” identity and two variants.

items.title: Maple Leaf Foods to close plant-based meat sites
items.summary: Maple Leaf Foods is to shut two US plant-based meat manufacturing sites as the Canadian food company seeks to improve profitability. The post Maple Leaf Foods to close plant-based meat sites appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: First AVA city store exceeds expectations
items.summary: The compact city store that AVA opened in late August in downtown Leuven is off to a strong start: the initial results are exceeding expectations, especially in the office supplies category.

items.title: Kikkoman expands US production with $560M soy sauce plant
items.summary: The Japanese food manufacturer is expanding in the states in response to growing consumer demand for international flavors and cuisines.

items.title: General Mills Beats First-Quarter Sales Estimates
items.summary: General Mills beat first-quarter sales estimates, helped by improved demand for pantry staples and breakfast cereals as more consumers choose to eat at hom...

items.title: Growth of nearly 25% “proves that Pop Mart is more than just Labubu”
items.summary: Pop Mart, the Chinese company behind gadgets such as Labubu, posted a 23.8% increase in revenue in the first half of 2026. The group is particularly proud of this achievement, as there had been fears that the retailer itself would fade away along with the Labubu hype.

items.title: Aldi Cuts US Grocery Prices Amid Inflation, Competition Pressure
items.summary: Discount grocer Aldi said it would lower prices on a range of grocery items in the US this autumn, a move the company estimates will save shoppers about $8...

items.title: Food-Based Dietary Guidelines 'Often Inadequate', Say Professionals
items.summary: While more than 100 countries worldwide – covering 90% of the global population – have developed national food-based dietary guidelin...

items.title: Intermarché Unveils 100 New Private-Label Products, Formats And Innovations
items.summary: French supermarket chain Intermarché is expanding its private-label portfolio with the roll-out of nearly 100 new products.

items.title: Bronco Wine to handle sales for “complementary” Wente Family Estates
items.summary: Bronco Wine Company will be the exclusive US sales organisation for Wente Family Estates under a nationwide partnership.

items.title: Investigation into social security fraud at two Delhaize supermarkets
items.summary: The court is investigating possible social security fraud at two Delhaize supermarkets that employ foreign workers to restock shelves and clean the stores. The stores in question have not yet been named as suspects.
